card.meaningEn: Forming a united whole; when the parts fit and work together well.
card.howUsed: Used for teams, groups, writing and designs whose parts connect well. Common in academic writing (“a cohesive argument”) and in software (“a cohesive module” does one clear job).
examples: After the retreat, the team felt much more cohesive.
Your essay needs a more cohesive structure.
The engineering team maintained a cohesive workflow throughout the sprint.
Each microservice should have cohesive responsibilities.
